title: New Aircrafts & Stunning Liveries in MSFS2024 Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | Week 50
description:
🔍 Description
🚀This week, several new livery packs have arrived in the marketplace, featuring both third-party and default aircraft. From Cessnas to Boeings, there’s something for everyone. And if you’re more into driving a buggy, there’s even a package for that too.🌍🛫
